cause_quote: The new ProgressRuntime detail was built as formatUiExternalText(...).slice(0, 240), a plain UTF-16 slice that can split an emoji surrogate pair.
user_saw: A session progress card's failed-run or failed-child detail could end in a broken replacement character when the 240-unit cut landed inside an emoji.
summary: Replaced the plain .slice(0, 240) on the progress card runtime error detail with the existing surrogate-safe truncateUtf16Safe.
reasoning: Blame of all removed lines points to 58b88a8b0a80, whose diff adds the ProgressRuntime component including the .slice(0, 240) detail; the feature and the unsafe cut shipped together. formatUiExternalText only trims and redacts, so nothing upstream made the slice safe.
